Authors: Balint Varga, Sebastian Fritz, Gergely Kiss, Kristof Takacs, Peter Galambos

HumanCOIN: A 12,500-Hour Dataset for Human Intent in Egocentric Manipulation Manipulation

egocentric manipulation dataset human intent gaze inference surface EMG scalp EEG

简要说明：HumanCOIN是一个大规模第一人称操作数据集（12,500小时），通过三层代理（注视、肌电、脑电）以及多视角RGB、深度、点云和位姿记录人类意图，为操作任务中从视觉注意到皮层准备的意图通路建模提供了丰富数据。

TLDR: HumanCOIN is a large-scale egocentric manipulation dataset (12,500 hours) that records human intent through three proxy tiers (gaze, EMG, EEG) alongside multi-view RGB, depth, point clouds, and poses, providing rich data for modeling the intent pathway from visual attention to cortical preparation in manipulation tasks.

Abstract: First-person manipulation datasets treat the observation-action pair as the atomic unit and compress the generation and execution of an action into a policy network's weights, rendering the intent state behind the action unobservable. Human motor control research shows that intent mediates between observation and action and leaves observable traces along the intent pathway from decision to effect: gaze reaches the target before the hand, muscle load builds before contact, and cortical activity precedes the motor command. To record this pathway at scale, we present HumanCOIN, a first-person manipulation dataset built around human intent: 12,500 hours across 38 scene classes with three tiers of proxies. At the output end, the L1 attention tier (10,000 h) infers gaze from headband camera video, exposing the operator's next object of attention and reach before the hand moves. Midway, the L2 exertion tier (2,000 h) records surface EMG from armbands, making load expectations readable before execution is complete. At the origin, the L3 cognition tier (500 h) records scalp EEG, giving early readouts of task decisions and monitoring. Each tier inherits all proxies from the tiers below. The dataset further provides multi-view RGB images, depth maps and point clouds, 6-DoF head and wrist pose, and step-level action and object annotations. The controlled L3 setting additionally measures gaze, hand pose and finger kinematics directly. Clock and calibration data are released with the dataset so that any read rate can be re-aligned. The three tiers cover three stations, from visual orienting to cortical preparation, making the process behind visual-action pairs available for modeling at dataset scale. Project page: https://flagopen.github.io/HumanCOIN.

摘要（中文）：第一人称操作数据集将观测-动作对视为原子单元，并将动作的生成与执行压缩进策略网络的权重中，使得动作背后的意图状态不可观测。人类运动控制研究表明，意图在观测与动作之间起中介作用，并沿从决策到效应的意图通路留下可观测痕迹：注视先于手到达目标，肌肉负荷在接触前建立，皮层活动先于运动指令产生。为大规模记录这一通路，我们提出了HumanCOIN，一个围绕人类意图构建的第一人称操作数据集：涵盖38个场景类别、共计12,500小时的数据，并包含三个层次的代理信号。在输出端，L1注意层次（10,000小时）通过头戴摄像头视频推断注视点，在手部移动前即揭示操作者的下一个注意对象及伸手方向。在中段，L2用力层次（2,000小时）通过臂带记录表面肌电信号，使动作执行完成前即可读取负荷预期。在源头，L3认知层次（500小时）记录头皮脑电信号，提供任务决策与监控的早期读出。每一层次均继承其下层所有代理信号。数据集还提供多视角RGB图像、深度图和点云、6自由度头部与手腕位姿，以及步骤级动作和物体标注。受控的L3设置还直接测量注视、手部姿态和手指运动学。数据集附带时钟与标定数据，任何采样率均可重新对齐。三个层次覆盖从视觉定向到皮层准备的三个站点，使视觉-动作对背后的过程可在数据集规模上进行建模。项目页面：https://flagopen.github.io/HumanCOIN。

LocoMuJoCo: A Comprehensive Imitation Learning Benchmark for Whole-Body Control Locomotion

whole-body control imitation learning sim-to-real MuJoCo/MJX motion capture

简要说明：LocoMuJoCo是一个用于全身控制的模仿学习和强化学习的开源基准测试，提供多种体态、动作捕捉数据集、重定向流程和基于JAX的算法，并支持sim-to-real部署。

TLDR: LocoMuJoCo is an open-source benchmark and library for imitation and reinforcement learning on whole-body control, offering multiple embodiments, motion-capture datasets, retargeting pipelines, and JAX-based algorithms with sim-to-real support.

Abstract: LocoMuJoCo is an open-source benchmark for imitation learning (IL) and reinforcement learning (RL) on whole-body control. The library couples MuJoCo (CPU) with MJX and the MjWarp backend (GPU) under a single API, exposes 9 humanoid, 3 (musculo-)skeletal, and 4 quadruped embodiments, and ships a curated native motion-capture dataset for every humanoid, to which it can also retarget AMASS and LAFAN1. A modular plug-in architecture makes observations, rewards, control modes, terrains, and domain randomization fully interchangeable, while compact JAX implementations of many RL and IL algorithms provide JIT-compiled end-to-end training, and the companion loco-mujoco-real repository provides sim-to-real deployment. We describe the design, the SMPL-to-robot and robot-to-robot retargeting pipeline, and a usage example. LocoMuJoCo is released under MIT at https://github.com/robfiras/loco-mujoco.

摘要（中文）：LocoMuJoCo是一个面向全身控制的开源基准测试平台，用于模仿学习（IL）和强化学习（RL）。该库将MuJoCo（CPU）与MJX及MjWarp后端（GPU）统一在单一API下，提供了9种人形机器人、3种（肌肉）骨骼模型和4种四足机器人形态，并为每种人形机器人附带了一个精选的原生动作捕捉数据集，同时还能将AMASS和LAFAN1数据集重定向至对应模型。其模块化插件架构使得观测、奖励、控制模式、地形和领域随机化均可完全互换，而多种RL和IL算法的紧凑JAX实现提供了JIT编译的端到端训练，配套的loco-mujoco-real代码库则支持仿真到现实的部署。本文描述了该平台的设计、SMPL到机器人及机器人到机器人的重定向流程，并给出了使用示例。LocoMuJoCo以MIT许可证发布，代码托管于https://github.com/robfiras/loco-mujoco。

Authors: Firas Al-Hafez, Davide Tateo, Oleg Kaidanov, Aditya Bhatt, Artur Zelik, Zhengyi Luo, Jan Peters

I See You: Initial Multi-Robot LiDAR Registration with Mutual-Observation Checks Perception3D

multi-robot LiDAR registration coarse-to-fine alignment mutual-observation checks search-and-rescue real-world validation

简要说明：本文提出了一种集中式、可部署的多机器人LiDAR配准框架，通过相互观测检验拒绝错误的成对配准，提高配准精度并减少实际搜救场景中的注册失败。

TLDR: This paper presents a centralized, deployment-ready framework for multi-robot LiDAR registration that uses mutual-observation checks to reject incorrect pairwise alignments, improving accuracy and reducing registration failures in real-world search-and-rescue scenarios.

Abstract: Compared to single-robot deployments, multi-robot teams can significantly improve search-and-rescue (SAR) mission success by covering large areas in parallel. To collaborate effectively, these robots must be registered in a common reference frame. Standard registration methods typically rely on external infrastructure or significant map overlap, but real deployments require infrastructure-free, stationary initial alignment for immediate operation. While global LiDAR point cloud registration addresses this, existing single-scan methods often fail silently in aliased or degenerate environments. Approaches scaling beyond two agents also remain rarely evaluated in real-world scenarios. We propose a centralized, deployment-ready framework for pre-mission multi-robot registration. Our system performs pairwise coarse-to-fine alignment and actively rejects impossible pose hypotheses via deterministic plausibility checks. We validate the framework on a real-world custom dataset of four synchronized robots in various environments with ground truth. The checks reject more than a third of the incorrect pairwise registrations while falsely rejecting less than 1% of the correct ones, and reduce the number of team registrations with a wrong robot pose by 38%. Dataset and code are publicly available.

摘要（中文）：相较于单机器人部署，多机器人团队能够并行覆盖大范围区域，从而显著提升搜索与救援（SAR）任务的成功率。为实现有效协作，这些机器人必须统一到公共参考坐标系中。标准配准方法通常依赖外部基础设施或显著的地图重叠，而实际部署则需要无基础设施、静止初始对齐以便立即投入运行。虽然全局激光雷达点云配准可解决此问题，但现有单扫描方法在面对混叠或退化环境时往往无声失效。针对超过两个智能体的扩展方法在实际场景中的评估也较为罕见。我们提出了一种集中式、可直接部署的框架，用于任务前的多机器人配准。该系统执行成对粗到精对齐，并通过确定性合理性检查主动拒绝不可能的位姿假设。我们在包含四台同步机器人的真实自定义数据集上验证了该框架，涵盖多种环境并具备地面真值。该检查拒绝了超过三分之一错误的成对配准，同时错误拒绝正确配准的比例不足1%，并将团队配准中出现错误机器人位姿的数量减少了38%。数据集与代码均已公开。

Authors: Jonathan Lichtenfeld, Oskar von Stryk

Planning to Stop: Factored Certification and Terminal Repair for Noncircular Robots Other

motion planning certification noncircular robots terminal repair proof reuse

简要说明：GeoDiff 是一种运动程序规划器，通过结合原始目标停止集包含、见证引导的终端修复和分解证明编译，为非圆形机器人的紧凑空间导航提供认证，在平面图和 BARN 地图任务上显著提高了认证覆盖率。

TLDR: GeoDiff is a motion-program planner that certifies tight-space navigation for noncircular robots by combining original-goal stopped-set inclusion, witness-guided terminal repair, and factored proof compilation, significantly improving certification coverage over baselines on floorplan and BARN map tasks.

Abstract: Tight-space navigation requires a robot to clear obstacles and stop inside its goal despite uncertainty. We present GeoDiff, a motion-program planner coupling original-goal stopped-set inclusion, witness-guided terminal repair, and factored proof compilation. An exact feasible-translation characterization guides repair; request-local reuse reduces repeated geometric work. We establish conditions for compiler equivalence and reach-and-stop soundness. Across 11,440 floorplan-derived jobs, GeoDiff certifies 61/139 tasks at 5-cm tolerance within 15 s, versus 44/139 for the stop-set baseline. The strongest observed external certificate adapter certifies 13/139 tasks from 119/139 native routes, separating route availability from certification. On tasks derived from public BARN maps, GeoDiff certifies 202/270 at 5-cm tolerance for a Jackal-shaped body, versus 3/270 for the portal baseline. Development analyses distinguish emitter savings from solver coverage, and 1,420 route-tracking episodes characterize the execution interface. These results show how terminal reasoning and proof reuse increase finite-budget certification coverage while preserving the original physical task and goal.

摘要（中文）：狭窄空间导航要求机器人在存在不确定性的情况下清除障碍并停在目标点内。我们提出了GeoDiff，一种运动程序规划器，结合了原始目标停止集包含、见证引导的终端修复以及分解式证明编译。精确的可行平移刻画指导修复过程；请求局部复用减少了重复的几何计算。我们建立了编译器等价性以及到达并停止的可靠性的条件。在11,440个基于楼层平面图的任务中，GeoDiff在15秒内以5厘米容差认证了61/139项任务，而停止集基线为44/139。所观察到的最强外部证书适配器从119/139条原生路线中认证了13/139项任务，从而将路线可用性与认证过程相分离。在基于公开BARN地图的任务中，GeoDiff针对Jackal形状的机体在5厘米容差下认证了202/270项任务，而门户基线仅为3/270。开发分析区分了发射器节省与求解器覆盖率，并利用1,420次路线跟踪事件刻画了执行接口的特征。这些结果表明，终端推理和证明复用如何在保持原始物理任务和目标的同时，提高有限预算下的认证覆盖率。

Authors: Runtian Zheng, Congpeng Zhang, Ying Liu

A Practical Proprioceptive Data Collection Utility for the Unitree GO1 Locomotion

proprioceptive data Unitree Go1 data collection utility quadruped robot terrain classification

简要说明：本文介绍了一个用于 Unitree Go1 四足机器人的开源 GUI 工具，无需 ROS 即可采集本体感觉数据，并通过训练一个性能较弱的 terrain 分类器来展示其用途。

TLDR: This paper presents an open-source GUI utility for collecting proprioceptive data from the Unitree Go1 quadruped without ROS, and demonstrates its use by training a weak terrain classifier.

Abstract: The Unitree Go1 is a widely used platform for legged robotics research, yet collecting proprioceptive data from it is unnecessarily difficult: the Unitree SDK is sparsely documented, and ROS1 (Robot Operating System), the Go1's native middleware, is fully deprecated. We present an open-source graphical utility that enables researchers to reliably record proprioceptive data from the Go1, including joint states, IMU (Inertial Measurement Unit) readings, foot force sensor data, and gyroscope measurements, without requiring ROS expertise. The tool provides a simple GUI (Graphical User Interface) for starting, stopping, and labeling recordings in real time. The contribution of this paper is the collection utility. We characterize the acquisition quality of 51 recordings collected with it, including the achieved sampling rate and repeated samples. As a secondary, deliberately modest check that the data is useful, we train a terrain classifier on it. The results are weak: a Temporal Convolutional Network reaches about 38% accuracy on held-out recordings across ten terrain classes (10% would be chance), and a window-level split that ignores recording boundaries inflates the same measurement to about 99%. We report this as a demonstration that the logged signals carry terrain information, not as a competitive classifier. The utility is designed to lower the barrier to collecting Go1 proprioceptive data without ROS.

摘要（中文）：宇树Go1是腿式机器人研究中广泛使用的平台，然而从中采集本体感觉数据的难度不必要地高：宇树SDK文档稀疏，且Go1的原生中间件ROS1（机器人操作系统）已完全弃用。我们提出了一款开源图形化工具，使研究人员能够可靠地记录Go1的本体感觉数据，包括关节状态、IMU（惯性测量单元）读数、足底力传感器数据及陀螺仪测量值，且无需具备ROS专业知识。该工具提供简洁的GUI（图形用户界面），用于实时开始、停止及标注记录。本文的贡献在于该采集工具。我们表征了使用该工具采集的51组记录的数据质量，包括所达到的采样率及重复样本。作为次要且刻意保守的验证——即数据具有可用性——我们在该数据上训练了一个地形分类器。结果表明性能较弱：时间卷积网络在十个地形类别上对未参与训练的记录达到约38%的准确率（随机水平为10%），而忽略记录边界的窗口级划分则将该指标虚高至约99%。我们报告此结果仅用于证明所记录的信号包含地形信息，而非展示具竞争力的分类器。该工具旨在降低无需ROS采集Go1本体感觉数据的门槛。

Authors: Jack Anders Smitterberg, Tan Chen

Controlling the Humanoid Robot H1-2 With a Simulated Biologically Plausible Network HumanoidEmbodied

spiking neural network biologically plausible humanoid locomotion distillation e-prop

简要说明：本文提出了一种生物启发的脉冲神经网络用于人形机器人运动，通过从强化学习专家策略中蒸馏训练，并证明 e-prop 在全尺寸 H1-2 人形机器人上达到 100% 的存活率，与时间反向传播相当。

TLDR: This paper proposes a biologically inspired spiking neural network for humanoid locomotion, trained via distillation from a reinforcement learning expert, and demonstrates that e-prop achieves 100% survival rate on a full-size H1-2 humanoid, matching backpropagation through time.

Abstract: Artificial Spiking Neural Networks have gained remarkable attention in the last few years due to their proven ability in simulating biological neural cultures and producing similar activity and trends. Nevertheless, whether they can be trained for humanoid locomotion while retaining biological plausibility and robust performance at once remains an open question. We study this problem by proposing a biologically inspired spiking network, trained by different learning schemes and tested on the H1-2 Unitree Humanoid. These schemes differ in how recurrent weights are trained. Ordered from most to least biologically faithful, they are: a fixed reservoir mimicking an in-vitro neural culture, where recurrent weights are kept frozen and only a linear readout is trained, the same network but with its synapses trained by reward-modulated spike timing dependent plasticity and eligibility propagation, and finally backpropagation through time as a non biological baseline for comparison. All schemes relied on distillation of a reinforcement learning expert policy with dataset aggregation. We show that e-prop reached 100% survival rate matching backpropagation through time, whereas both the fixed reservoir and the reward-modulated STDP, though the closest to biological cultures, plateaued at a much lower performance (~43.7% and ~11% survival). We explore in further detail which trends a real culture could and could not produce until now. Finally we demonstrate brief bipedal stepping on a full size humanoid H1-2.

摘要（中文）：人工尖峰神经网络近年来因被证实能够模拟生物神经培养物并产生相似的活动与趋势而受到广泛关注。然而，这些网络能否在保持生物合理性和稳健性能的同时，被训练用于类人机器人运动，仍是一个悬而未决的问题。我们通过提出一种受生物启发的尖峰网络来研究这一问题，该网络采用不同的学习方案进行训练，并在H1-2 Unitree人形机器人上进行了测试。这些方案的不同之处在于循环权重的训练方式。按照生物保真度从高到低排列，它们分别是：一个模拟体外神经培养物的固定储备池，其中循环权重保持冻结，仅训练线性读出层；同一网络但突触通过奖励调节的尖峰时间依赖可塑性和资格传播进行训练；最后是通过时间反向传播作为非生物基线的对照方法。所有方案均依赖于强化学习专家策略的知识蒸馏与数据集聚合。我们表明，e-prop达到了100%的存活率，与时间反向传播相当，而固定储备池和奖励调节的STDP虽然最接近生物培养物，但其性能却停滞在较低水平（存活率分别约为43.7%和11%）。我们进一步详细探讨了迄今真实培养物能够和不能产生的趋势。最后，我们在全尺寸人形机器人H1-2上演示了短暂的双足行走。

Authors: Fatima Atwi, Constant Roux, Christian Bergaud, Olivier Stasse

Close&Safe: Maximal Task Preservation for Redundant Manipulators via C-Space Boundary Detour Manipulation

trajectory repair configuration-space boundary redundant manipulators contact-rich manipulation obstacle avoidance

简要说明：Close&Safe 提出一种冗余机械臂规划方法，在可行处严格保持标称末端轨迹，并在障碍物附近通过 C 空间边界采样局部绕行，实现碰撞避免且任务偏差最小化。

TLDR: Close&Safe proposes a planning method for redundant manipulators that preserves the nominal end-effector trajectory wherever feasible and locally detours around unexpected obstacles via C-space boundary sampling, achieving collision-free task repair with minimal deviation.

Abstract: Contact-rich manipulation such as wiping, polishing and surface inspection specifies the task as a continuous end-effector trajectory rather than a goal pose. When an obstacle absent from the planning model intersects it, conventional planners return a collision-free path that may differ from the nominal throughout, discarding trajectory that was never obstructed. We present Close&Safe (Close to the intended task, Safe from obstacles), which decouples tracking from avoidance: the nominal is followed exactly wherever it remains feasible, and avoidance acts only on the interval where it is not, so tracking is hindered as little as the obstacle allows. On that interval we sample the configuration-space obstacle boundary within a corridor around the nominal, connect the samples into a roadmap, and search it for the detour that deviates least before rejoining the nominal at the earliest feasible configuration. We evaluate across diverse simulated obstacle configurations, physical Franka experiments, and ablations of key algorithmic components. The results demonstrate collision-free trajectory repair with localized task modification, while recovering 52.4-78% in simulation and on hardware.

摘要（中文）：接触丰富的操作任务（如擦拭、抛光和表面检测）将任务定义为连续的末端执行器轨迹，而非目标位姿。当规划模型中未包含的障碍物与该轨迹相交时，传统规划器会返回一条整体上可能偏离标称轨迹的无碰撞路径，从而丢弃了本未受阻碍的轨迹部分。我们提出了Close&Safe方法（贴近预期任务，远离障碍物），将轨迹跟踪与避障解耦：在标称轨迹可行的位置严格沿其执行，仅在不可行的区间内启动避障，从而使跟踪受障碍物的影响降至最低。在该区间内，我们在标称轨迹周围的通道中采样构型空间中的障碍物边界，将样本连接为路标图，并搜索其中偏离最小、且能在最早可行构型处重新汇入标称轨迹的绕行路径。我们通过多种模拟障碍物配置、实体Franka机器人实验以及关键算法组件的消融研究进行了评估。结果表明，该方法实现了局部任务修改下的无碰撞轨迹修复，在仿真和硬件实验中恢复率达到52.4%-78%。

Authors: Abhigyan Singh, Manthan Goyal, Fares Abu-Dakka, Ravi Prakash

Fast and Accurate Body Estimation in Pixels, World Space and Scenes HumanoidEmbodied

human body estimation human-to-humanoid retargeting real-to-sim transfer contact prediction SAM 3D Body

简要说明：FAB 是一种快速准确的人体估计器，可预测密集的 2D/3D 人体点和接触点，支持高效的人到人形机器人的真实到仿真迁移。

TLDR: FAB is a fast and accurate human body estimator that predicts dense 2D/3D body points, skeleton joints, and contacts, enabling efficient human-to-humanoid real-to-sim transfer for a Unitree G1 robot.

Abstract: We present FAB (Fast and Accurate Body estimation), a human body estimator that jointly improves inference efficiency and body-recovery fidelity. Rather than predicting only parametric mesh-model parameters, FAB directly predicts human skeleton joints and dense surface points. In images, it predicts dense 2D and 3D body points alongside a parametric Momentum Human Rig (MHR) head, then fits SMPL in one learned pass followed by two Gauss-Newton steps. Its ViT-L student, FAB-L, distilled from a fine-tuned SAM 3D Body, runs in real time for one person on an RTX 4070 Ti SUPER, from detection to a fitted body, at 4.6x the speed of SAM 3D Body's eager-PyTorch body-only path, while improving accuracy on most camera-space benchmarks. The same network predicts heel, toe, hand, and knee contacts, which connect the body to the scene. FAB also estimates world-space motion, fuses static-scene depth around the visible person, and aligns body and scene using predicted contacts. For human-to-humanoid real-to-sim transfer, an in-model G1 head and FAB-Retarget, a motion-level retargeter that reads dense points or the fitted mesh, map motion to a Unitree G1. FAB-Retarget produces references that follow the person more closely than specialized retargeters including SOMA, GMR, UMR, and OmniRetarget, and substantially more closely than Fast SAM 3D Body retargeted with our sequence IK. Project page: https://www.jinkuncao.com/FAB.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了FAB（快速且精确的人体姿态估计），这是一种能够同时提升推理效率与人体恢复保真度的人体估计器。与仅预测参数化网格模型参数不同，FAB直接预测人体骨骼关节和密集表面点。在图像中，它预测密集的2D和3D人体点，同时结合参数化动量人体骨架（MHR）头部，随后在单次学习前向传播后跟两个高斯-牛顿步骤来拟合SMPL模型。其ViT-L学生模型FAB-L，从微调后的SAM 3D Body中蒸馏而来，在RTX 4070 Ti SUPER上对单个人体实现了从检测到拟合身体的实时运行，速度达到SAM 3D Body基于急切PyTorch的仅身体路径的4.6倍，同时在大多数相机空间基准上提高了准确性。同一网络还预测脚跟、脚趾、手和膝盖的接触点，这些接触点将人体与场景连接起来。FAB还估计世界空间运动，融合可见人体周围的静态场景深度，并利用预测的接触点对齐人体与场景。对于从人体到人形机器人的真实到模拟迁移，模型内置的G1头部和FAB-Retarget（一种读取密集点或拟合网格的运动级重定向器）将运动映射到Unitree G1。FAB-Retarget生成的参考动作比SOMA、GMR、UMR和OmniRetarget等专用重定向器更紧密地跟随人体，并且比使用我们的序列逆运动学重定向的Fast SAM 3D Body紧密得多。项目页面：https://www.jinkuncao.com/FAB。

Authors: Jinkun Cao

Collision-Free Is Not Enough: Passage-Conditioned Navigation for Wheeled-Legged Robots Locomotion

passage-conditioned navigation wheeled-legged robot terrain transitions local replanning entry gate

简要说明：本文提出了一种路径条件导航方法，该方法存储地形转换的教学穿越，并在局部重规划后通过入口门强制实施，从而在没有训练或机器人模型的情况下提高轮腿式机器人导航的鲁棒性，并在仿真和真实机器人竞赛中得到了验证。

TLDR: The paper proposes passage-conditioned navigation, a method that stores taught crossings of terrain transitions and enforces them via entry gates after local replanning, improving robustness of wheeled-legged robot navigation without training or robot models, validated in simulation and on a real robot in a competition.

Abstract: A collision-free detour can still bring a legged robot to the next stair or ledge a few centimetres or degrees off, and a fixed locomotion skill, factory or learned, can stall or fall. Existing methods prevent this with a robot model or extensive trial and error, but on a new site with unknown skills neither is available, so they cannot be used. We find that a single 27-minute teaching session already supplies what these methods have to derive or learn: for every stair and ledge, one crossing the skill has completed. Our method, passage-conditioned navigation, makes the route remember how each transition was entered, not only where the path went. It stores each taught crossing as an event and, without training or a robot model, enforces it after every local replan: before each ledge, an entry gate makes the robot turn or back up and retry if it is more than 10 cm or 10° off the taught crossing. Under localization noise, with path, gait schedule, and sensing unchanged, this raises the share of disturbed ledge crossings that stay within these limits from 24.1% to 88.6%. In contact simulation with our learned policies, a robot pushed off course before stairs never falls in 180 climbs, against 9 falls when the stored direction is ignored; pushed 1.2 m away, it rejoins the route, ending on average 0.14 m from it (1.10 m without rejoining), and finishes as often as an undisturbed robot. This suits any robot with fixed skills that repeats a route over terrain transitions, as in inspection and patrol, where one wrong entry can end the task. We deployed it in competition on a real wheeled-legged robot: over 271 m of multi-obstacle terrain spanning 7.0 m of elevation, it completed all six runs, won third place at the 2026 Global Open-source AI Challenge, which drew 2,999 submissions, and was the only finalist in its task to finish fully autonomously.

摘要（中文）：即使存在绕行，腿式机器人仍可能偏离下一级台阶或边缘几厘米或几度，而固定的运动技能（无论是工厂预设还是学习获得）则可能因此停滞或摔倒。现有方法通过机器人模型或大量试错来避免这一问题，但在新场地且技能未知的情况下，两者均不可用，因此这些方法无法适用。我们发现，仅需一次27分钟的教学过程，便能提供这些方法需要推导或学习的内容：对于每一级台阶和边缘，技能已完成一次跨越。我们的方法——通道条件导航（passage-conditioned navigation）——使路径不仅记录走过的路线，还记住每次过渡的进入方式。它将每次教授跨越存储为一个事件，并在每次局部重规划后无需训练或机器人模型即可强制执行：在每个边缘前，一个入口门控使机器人转向或后退，若偏离教授跨越超过10厘米或10度则重试。在定位噪声下，保持路径、步态调度和感知不变，该方法将受扰边缘跨越中保持在这些界限内的比例从24.1%提升至88.6%。在使用我们学习策略的接触仿真中，机器人在楼梯前被推离路线，180次攀爬中从未摔倒，而忽略存储方向时发生9次摔倒；被推离1.2米后，它重新汇入路线，最终平均偏离0.14米（不重新汇入时为1.10米），并像未受扰动的机器人一样频繁完成任务。该方法适用于任何具有固定技能、在巡检和巡逻等地形过渡中重复路线的机器人，此时一次错误进入便可能终止任务。我们在真实轮腿机器人的竞赛中进行了部署：在跨越7.0米高差的271米多障碍地形上，机器人完成全部六次运行，在吸引2,999份参赛作品的2026年全球开源AI挑战赛中荣获第三名，并且是其任务中唯一完全自主完赛的决赛选手。

Authors: Wai Ka Sun, Waiyiu Pong, Bowen Wang

LeCompass: Task-Level Execution through State-Indexed Interfaces WorldModel

world model state-indexed execution predictive search latent target proposal spatial feedback

简要说明：LeCompass 是一个基于冻结世界模型的状态索引执行框架，通过潜在目标提议、预测搜索和空间反馈实现任务级执行；在 Cube 上达到 86.9% 的成功率，并在 PushT 和 TwoRoom 上取得大幅提升。

TLDR: LeCompass is a state-indexed execution framework built around a frozen world model, enabling task-level execution via latent target proposal, predictive search, and spatial feedback; it achieves 86.9% success on Cube, and large gains on PushT and TwoRoom.

Abstract: Action-conditioned joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) offer a foundation for predictive decision-making by modeling the consequences of actions in representation space. Yet evaluating local reachability in latent space does not by itself provide a task-level execution interface: intermediate targets must be generated, local inference has finite budgets, and execution requires spatial feedback and persistent interaction state. We introduce LeCompass, a state-indexed execution framework built around a frozen LeWorldModel (LeWM). A proposer supplies intermediate latent targets, while CompassFlow searches the source space of a learned trajectory prior to obtain effective action candidates under limited predictive-evaluation budgets. Patch-token readouts provide spatial feedback, while observation-based memory supports phase transitions and bounded recovery. State-indexed targets support cross-episode context-goal composition. On 1,000 official TEST full-episode Cube trials, the complete LeCompass execution system achieves 86.9% native 4-cm reach. Separate matched analyses show that predictive ranking raises success from 4.7% to 44.9% on TEST PushT and from 33.8% to 77.7% on TEST TwoRoom. These results demonstrate task-level execution with task-dependent roles for latent target proposal, predictive search, and observation-grounded control.

摘要（中文）：基于动作条件的联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs）通过在表示空间中建模动作的后果，为预测性决策提供了基础。然而，仅在潜在空间中评估局部可达性本身并不能提供任务级的执行接口：中间目标必须被生成，局部推理具有有限的预算，且执行需要空间反馈和持续交互状态。我们提出了LeCompass，一个围绕冻结的LeWorldModel（LeWM）构建的状态索引执行框架。提议器提供中间潜在目标，而CompassFlow在有限预测评估预算下，搜索学习到的轨迹先验的源空间以获取有效的动作候选。补丁令牌读出提供空间反馈，而基于观察的记忆支持相位转换和有界恢复。状态索引目标支持跨情节的上下文目标组合。在1，000次官方TEST完整魔方试验中，完整的LeCompass执行系统实现了86.9%的原生4厘米到达率。分离的匹配分析表明，预测排序将TEST PushT的成功率从4.7%提升至44.9%，将TEST TwoRoom的成功率从33.8%提升至77.7%。这些结果展示了任务级执行，以及潜在目标提议、预测搜索和基于观察的控制在其中的任务相关角色。

Authors: Kai Shi, Shiqi Zhao, Zimo Li, Hairong Qu, Hongyu Ma, Yongsong Yang, Jiahao Ai, Ziran Yin, Peng Yin

GraF-VTA: Neuro-Symbolic Trajectory Generation from Vision and Temporal Logic via Graph-Based Fusion VLA

signal temporal logic vision-language-action flow matching closed-loop replanning trajectory generation

简要说明：GraF-VTA 提出一种基于图的神经符号框架，通过交叉注意力与时间金字塔融合视觉、信号时序逻辑和机器人状态，生成满足STL的机器人轨迹，并在仿真中实现更高的Success@K。

TLDR: GraF-VTA introduces a graph-based neuro-symbolic framework that fuses vision, signal temporal logic (STL), and robot state via cross-attention and temporal pyramids to generate STL-satisfying robot trajectories with closed-loop replanning, achieving higher Success@K than baselines in simulation.

Abstract: Robotic planning from visual observations and signal temporal logic (STL) requires grounding task requirements in scene evidence while adapting plans to execution feedback. We present GraF-VTA, a graph-based framework that extends Vision-TL-Action with structured task representations, causal observation history, and closed-loop trajectory generation. Bidirectional cross-attention fuses STL syntax tokens with visual features, while an optional frozen automaton embedding supplies complementary untimed task structure. A temporal pyramid preserves detailed current observations and compresses older frames to provide recent execution context. Conditioned on these features and robot state, a flow-matching model generates plans whose action prefixes are executed before replanning from refreshed observations. Across five simulation environments, the single-graph configuration achieves higher open-loop Success@$K$ than TeLoGraF and Vision-TL-Action on four environments at the reported budgets $K\geq16$. On Panda, matched-update ablations increase Success@256 from 53.91\% without observation history to 62.50\% with pyramid memory. In closed-loop Dubins evaluation, it reaches 64.06\% Success@1024, compared with 12.50\% for adapted S-MSP and 27.34\% for adapted Logic-VLA. These results support combining structured visual conditioning with observation history and replanning to improve coverage of STL-satisfying trajectories.

摘要（中文）：基于视觉观测和信号时序逻辑（STL）的机器人规划，需要将任务需求锚定于场景证据，同时使规划适应执行反馈。我们提出了GraF-VFA，一个基于图结构的框架，通过结构化任务表示、因果观测历史和闭环轨迹生成来扩展Vision-TL-Action。双向交叉注意力将STL语法标记与视觉特征融合，同时一个可选的冻结自动机嵌入提供互补的非时序任务结构。时间金字塔保留详细的当前观测并压缩较旧的帧，以提供近期的执行上下文。基于这些特征和机器人状态，流匹配模型生成规划，其动作前缀在执行后，从刷新后的观测进行重新规划。在五个仿真环境中，单一图配置在报告的预算$K\geq16$下，在四个环境中的开环Success@$K$指标上优于TeLoGraF和Vision-TL-Action。在Panda环境中，匹配更新的消融实验将Success@256从无观测历史的53.91\%提高到带金字塔记忆的62.50\%。在闭环Dubins评估中，它达到了64.06\%的Success@1024，而改编的S-MSP为12.50\%，改编的Logic-VLA为27.34\%。这些结果支持将结构化视觉条件与观测历史和重规划相结合，以提高满足STL约束轨迹的覆盖率。

Authors: Zezhi Liu, Zhiwei Zheng, Hanqian Luo, Deyun Qin, Shizhen Wu, Yongchun Fang

Learning Ankle Exoskeleton Control for Reactive Standing Balance Through Neuromusculoskeletal Simulation Locomotion

ankle exoskeleton reactive balance neuromusculoskeletal simulation reinforcement learning sim-to-real

简要说明：本文提出了一种从仿真到现实的框架，利用神经肌肉骨骼模型和强化学习开发踝关节外骨骼控制器，用于反应性站立平衡，并在健康受试者中验证了其改善平衡恢复的效果。

TLDR: This paper presents a simulation-to-real framework that uses a neuromusculoskeletal model and reinforcement learning to develop an ankle exoskeleton controller for reactive standing balance, demonstrating improved balance recovery in healthy subjects.

Abstract: Deficits in reactive balance can increase fall risk among older adults and individuals with neuromuscular impairments, motivating the need for interventions that improve balance recovery. Wearable robotic exoskeletons offer a promising approach to addressing this need by augmenting balance control. However, developing controllers that deliver appropriately timed and scaled assistance remains challenging, as evaluating each candidate strategy requires repeated exposure to destabilizing perturbations. We propose a simulation-to-real framework that combines motion imitation and reinforcement learning to develop balance-assistive ankle exoskeleton control. A muscle-driven neuromusculoskeletal model was trained using a small set of motion-capture data from a single subject to reproduce kinematic and kinetic responses to backward-translation perturbations. This model served as a virtual human for training a reinforcement-learning exoskeleton controller. The resulting controller generated bilateral ankle assistance using only inertial sensor measurements, without explicit perturbation detection. We implemented the controller on-board a bilateral ankle exoskeleton and evaluated it in five healthy subjects whose data were not used for training. Assistance increased the perturbation magnitude that subjects could withstand without stepping by 11.8% and reduced peak center-of-mass displacement and velocity by 13.5% and 28.2%, respectively. Individual benefits varied with baseline recovery strategy and body mass. These results indicate that a single virtual human can yield transferable balance assistance, and that more diverse virtual humans could further improve its effectiveness.

摘要（中文）：反应性平衡能力的缺陷会增加老年人和神经肌肉受损人群的跌倒风险，因此亟需能够改善平衡恢复能力的干预措施。可穿戴机器人外骨骼通过增强平衡控制，为满足这一需求提供了一种有前景的解决方案。然而，由于评估每种候选策略都需要反复暴露于失稳扰动中，开发能够提供适时、适度辅助的控制器仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了一种结合动作模仿和强化学习的仿真到现实框架，用于开发平衡辅助踝关节外骨骼控制。利用来自单名受试者的一小组动作捕捉数据，训练了一个肌肉驱动的神经肌肉骨骼模型，以再现对向后平移扰动的运动学和动力学响应。该模型作为虚拟人，用于训练强化学习外骨骼控制器。由此产生的控制器仅利用惯性传感器测量值生成双侧踝关节辅助，无需显式扰动检测。我们将该控制器实现在双侧踝关节外骨骼上，并在五名未参与训练的健康受试者中进行了评估。辅助使受试者能够承受而不需要跨步的扰动幅度增加了11.8%，并将质心峰值位移和速度分别降低了13.5%和28.2%。个体获益程度因基线恢复策略和体重而异。这些结果表明，单个虚拟人即可产生可迁移的平衡辅助，而更多样化的虚拟人可进一步提高其有效性。

Authors: Maria T. Tagliaferri, Inseung Kang

Demonstration-Free Skill Composition for Navigation and Manipulation Manipulation

hierarchical reinforcement learning skill composition navigation manipulation demonstration-free

简要说明：本文评估了无演示的分层强化学习管线在MiniGrid导航和机器人操作中的应用，表明组合技能相比平坦RL基线在训练效率和性能上更优。

TLDR: This paper evaluates demonstration-free hierarchical reinforcement learning pipelines for MiniGrid navigation and robotic manipulation, showing that composed parameterized skills outperform flat RL baselines in training efficiency and performance.

Abstract: Hierarchical reinforcement learning enables sequential tasks to be represented as compositions of separately trained skills. This paper evaluates demonstration-free hierarchical pipelines for MiniGrid navigation and robotic manipulation, comparing their training requirements and task performance with flat reinforcement learning baselines. The evaluation concerns complete pipelines with task-specific observation, reward and control structures. In navigation, two parameterised skills are reused across unseen FourRooms layouts under manually specified high-level plans. In manipulation, reaching, grasp alignment and lifting are trained separately, with downstream skills initialised from states collected during predecessor rollouts. Across unseen navigation layouts, the hierarchical pipeline substantially outperforms the evaluated flat DQN baselines while requiring fewer training interactions. In manipulation, the hierarchical chain requires fewer training steps than flat SAC and exhibits lower observed variation across seeds. The frozen Pick and Lift skills are further reused for stacking by training an additional Place skill.

摘要（中文）：分层强化学习使顺序任务能够表示为分别训练的技能的组合。本文评估了无需演示的分层流程在MiniGrid导航和机器人操作中的应用，并将其训练要求与任务性能同平面强化学习基线进行了比较。评估涵盖了具有任务特定观测、奖励和控制结构的完整流程。在导航中，两个参数化技能在手工指定的高层计划下，被复用于未见过的FourRooms布局。在操作任务中，抓取对准和提升分别进行训练，后续技能从前序回合收集的状态中初始化。在未见过的导航布局中，分层流程显著优于所评估的平面DQN基线，且所需的训练交互更少。在操作任务中，分层链比平面SAC所需的训练步骤更少，且不同随机种子间的观测变异性更低。冻结的拾取和提升技能通过额外训练放置技能进一步复用于堆叠任务。

Authors: Madeleine Nouri, Gelareh Mohammadi, Francisco Cruz

Stereo Visual Odometry with In-the-Loop Geometric Feed-Forward Models Towards Dense Metric Mapping Perception3D

stereo visual odometry geometric feed-forward models factor-graph optimization dense metric mapping Generalised ICP

简要说明：本文提出将几何前馈模型的密集深度预测与基于因子图的双目视觉里程计相结合，利用优化的三维地标校准深度预测，实现准确的定位与稠密度量建图。

TLDR: This paper integrates geometric feed-forward models for dense depth with factor-graph stereo visual odometry to achieve accurate localization and dense metric mapping, using optimized 3D landmarks to calibrate depth predictions and hierarchical optimization for efficiency.

Abstract: We present a stereo visual odometry (SVO) framework that integrates geometric feed-forward models (GFMs) for dense depth prediction with factor-graph-based visual odometry to achieve accurate localisation and dense metric mapping. Our key idea is to exploit sparse but reliable metric geometry estimated from stereo and temporal multi-view observations to calibrate dense GFM predictions, while retaining the robustness and efficiency of model-based SVO. Rather than directly conditioning the GFM on potentially noisy stereo depth, optimised 3D landmarks are used to jointly estimate a scale-shift transformation over all keyframes within each local submap, yielding metrically consistent dense depth predictions. To balance accuracy and computational efficiency, we introduce a hierarchical factor-graph architecture. At the local level, sliding-window optimisation estimates high-frequency camera poses and multi-view-refined 3D landmarks. Dense predictions are generated only for selected keyframes and registered within each submap using SE(3) Generalised ICP. Consecutive submaps are further aligned in Sim(3) using their shared geometry, allowing residual scale inconsistencies to be corrected. These intra- and inter-submap constraints are incorporated into a global factor graph to produce a consistent trajectory and dense metric reconstruction. Extensive experiments on public and in-house datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves competitive odometry accuracy against geometric and learning-based baselines while providing accurate dense metric reconstruction and improved robustness to failures in learned depth prediction.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了一种立体视觉里程计（SVO）框架，该框架将用于稠密深度预测的几何前馈模型（GFMs）与基于因子图的视觉里程计相集成，以实现高精度的定位和稠密度量建图。我们的核心思想是利用从立体和多时序多视角观测中估计出的稀疏但可靠的度量几何来校准稠密的GFM预测，同时保持基于模型的SVO的鲁棒性和效率。为了避免将可能含有噪声的立体深度直接作为GFM的条件输入，我们使用优化后的三维地标点在每个局部子图内的所有关键帧上联合估计尺度-平移变换，从而生成度量一致的稠密深度预测。为了在精度与计算效率之间取得平衡，我们引入了一种层次化因子图架构。在局部层面，滑动窗口优化估计高频相机位姿以及经多视角优化后的三维地标点。仅对选定的关键帧生成稠密预测，并使用SE(3)广义ICP在子图内进行配准。连续子图之间进一步利用其共享几何在Sim(3)空间中进行对齐，从而修正残存的尺度不一致性。这些子图内部及子图间的约束被纳入全局因子图中，以生成一致的轨迹和稠密度量重建。在公开数据集和自采数据集上的大量实验表明，所提出的框架在里程计精度上与几何方法和基于学习的方法相比具有竞争力，同时能提供准确的稠密度量重建，并增强了对学习型深度预测失败的鲁棒性。

Authors: Fahira Afzal Maken, Sagun Man Singh Shrestha, Edward Vanderfeen, Lucas Carvalho de Lima, Rongxin Li, Changming Sun, Milad Ramezani

MIR-Depth: Multi-Range Refinement for Single-View RGB-D Depth Completion of Transparent Objects Perception3D

depth completion transparent objects RGB-D robotic grasping inverse depth

简要说明：MIR-Depth 提出了一种多范围细化方法，通过坐标感知的多范围假设和选择性循环细化来改进透明物体的单视图 RGB-D 深度补全，并在多个基准和真实机器人实验中验证了其有效性。

TLDR: MIR-Depth proposes a multi-range refinement approach using coordinate-aware multi-range hypotheses and selective recurrent refinement to improve single-view RGB-D depth completion of transparent objects for robotic grasping, validated on multiple benchmarks and real-robot experiments.

Abstract: Recovering accurate visible-surface depth from a single RGB-D image and an object mask is essential for robotic grasping and manipulation of transparent objects. Specular reflections cause missing depth, while refraction corrupts nonzero returns with background depth, making raw measurements unreliable as surface anchors. Under a fixed sampling budget, refining an initial single-view prediction within a single search interval either misses large refraction offsets or sacrifices fine local resolution. To resolve this single-view trade-off, MIR-Depth constructs Coordinate-Aware Multi-Range Hypotheses: a 3D-aggregated global inverse-depth volume and depth-axis-filtered pixel-wise local volumes around a prior-guided initial depth. Selective Recurrent Refinement then introduces out-of-bounds lookup masking and validity-masked softmax fusion to iteratively update inverse depth from these volumes using a multi-scale ConvGRU. Finally, Spatially Gated Correction applies a learned per-pixel spatial gate to the full-resolution residual, preserving accurate initial geometry without imposing raw sensor readings as hard constraints. Experiments on TransCG, TODD, TRansPose, ClearPose, and HouseCat6D show that MIR-Depth achieves lower error than ReMake, DFNet, BP-Net, and PSD. Real-robot evaluations confirm accurate surface geometry for 6-DoF grasp pose prediction. Code and pretrained models will be publicly available.

摘要（中文）：从单个RGB-D图像和对象掩码中恢复准确的可见表面深度，对于透明物体的机器人抓取与操作至关重要。镜面反射会导致深度缺失，而折射则用背景深度污染非零返回值，使得原始测量值无法作为可靠的表面对齐锚点。在固定采样预算下，在单一搜索区间内对初始单视图预测进行细化，要么遗漏大的折射偏移，要么牺牲精细的局部分辨率。为解决这一单视图权衡问题，MIR-Depth构建了坐标感知的多范围假设体：一个三维聚合的全局逆深度体，以及在先验引导的初始深度周围构建的深度轴滤波的逐像素局部体。随后，选择性循环细化引入越界查找掩码和有效性掩蔽的Softmax融合，利用多尺度ConvGRU从这些体积中迭代更新逆深度。最后，空间门控校正将学习的逐像素空间门应用于全分辨率残差，在保留准确初始几何结构的同时，不将原始传感器读数作为硬性约束。在TransCG、TODD、TRansPose、ClearPose和HouseCat6D上的实验表明，MIR-Depth比ReMake、DFNet、BP-Net和PSD实现了更低的误差。真实机器人评估确认了其用于六自由度抓取姿态预测的准确表面几何结构。代码和预训练模型将公开发布。

Authors: Xinzhe Fu, Qi Shao, Yuanfei Xie, Taoyu Wu, Zhihao Cao, Long Hu, Hong Liang, Xianzhi Li, Anh Nguyen, Baoru Huang, Rongsheng Li

Stuck in Place: Stall Diagnosis and Remedies for JEPA Planners WorldModel

JEPA world model model predictive control test-time adaptation planning

简要说明：本文分析了基于JEPA世界模型的规划器在推动任务中的失败，发现大多数失败是由暖启动GD规划器的固定点导致的停滞。他们提出了Unstick，将on-policy微调与固定权重循环打破器（记忆或重新初始化）相结合，以恢复大部分适应性收益。

TLDR: This paper analyzes failures of JEPA-based world model planners in pushing tasks, finding that most failures are stalls caused by a fixed point in the warm-started GD planner. They propose Unstick, which combines on-policy fine-tuning with a fixed-weight loop breaker (memory or re-initialization) to recover most adaptation gains.

Abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) world models plan from pixels with model predictive control, yet often fail on tasks their model should handle. Test-time adaptation attributes such failures to model error under distribution shift and updates the weights on the current episode, without checking this attribution against the planning loop itself. We follow the executed planning loop on pushing tasks. In most settings, with and without distribution shift, nearly all failures (at least 96%) are stalls, where the object stays in place while the model predicts progress. The warm-started gradient-descent (GD) planner then returns nearly the same plan, a fixed point where the agent mostly idles. We propose Unstick, which pairs on-policy fine-tuning before deployment with a fixed-weight loop breaker: a residual memory of the episode's prediction errors or random re-initialization at every replan. With GD, Unstick recovers most of the adaptation gain on pushing tasks with the memory, and with re-initialization most of it on shape shifts but much less on visual shifts. A large part of what limits these planners under GD is thus a fixed point of the planning loop, present with and without distribution shift, which a planner with fixed weights can break. Code is available at https://github.com/jhlee0619/unstick.

摘要（中文）：联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）世界模型通过模型预测控制从像素层面进行规划，但其模型本应处理的任务上却常常失败。测试时自适应将此类失败归因于分布偏移下的模型误差，并在当前回合中更新权重，而未针对规划循环本身检验这一归因。我们在推动任务中沿用了所执行的规划循环。在大多数情况下，无论是否存在分布偏移，几乎所有失败（至少96%）均为停滞现象，即物体保持不动而模型预测有进展。此时，热启动的梯度下降（GD）规划器几乎返回相同的规划，形成一个智能体大多处于空转状态的固定点。我们提出Unstick方法，将部署前的在策略微调与固定权重的循环打破机制相结合：即利用回合预测误差的残差记忆，或在每次重新规划时进行随机重新初始化。结合GD，Unstick通过记忆机制在推动任务上恢复了大部分自适应增益，而通过重新初始化在形状偏移上恢复了大部分增益，但在视觉偏移上恢复较少。因此，限制这些GD规划器性能的很大一部分因素来自规划循环的固定点，该固定点在有无分布偏移的情况下均存在，而固定权重的规划器可以打破这一固定点。代码可在 https://github.com/jhlee0619/unstick 获取。

Authors: Junhyeok Lee, Dongheon Lee, Kyu Sung Choi

RefreshGrad: An Online Adaptive Data-sampling Method for Diffusion-based Visuomotor Learning VLA

data sampling visuomotor learning VLA adaptive weighting manipulation

简要说明：RefreshGrad 提出了一种针对 VLA 策略的在线自适应数据采样方法，根据不断演变的策略原生信号动态重新加权演示时间窗口，提高了 LIBERO-Plus 操作任务的成功率。

TLDR: RefreshGrad introduces an online adaptive data-sampling method for VLA policies that dynamically reweights temporal demonstration windows based on evolving policy-native signals, improving success rates on LIBERO-Plus manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Training vision-language-action (VLA) policies from demonstrations typically samples trajectory segments uniformly or relies on static offline data curation before training. However, we find that demonstration data vary sharply in supervision value across temporal windows, and that each window's value to the policy evolves substantially during training rather than being fixed or captured by raw loss alone. Motivated by this finding, we propose RefreshGrad, an online adaptive data-sampling framework that periodically scores temporal windows from the evolving policy using five policy-native signals and dynamically adjusts their sampling weights during training. RefreshGrad focuses optimization on informative, learnable windows without altering the policy architecture, training objective, or inference cost. Across ten LIBERO-Plus manipulation tasks, RefreshGrad boosts average success from 60.7% (Uniform) and 68.2% (FAKTUAL) to 76.1% under visual perturbations, and from 57.4% and 73.3% to 81.3% in clean scenes.

摘要（中文）：训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略时，通常从示范数据中均匀采样轨迹片段，或在训练前依赖于静态的离线数据整理。然而，我们发现示范数据在不同时间窗口内的监督价值差异显著，且每个窗口对策略的价值在训练过程中会大幅演化，并非固定不变，也不能仅由原始损失值直接反映。基于这一发现，我们提出了RefreshGrad，一种在线自适应数据采样框架，它利用五种策略原生信号定期对时间窗口进行评分，并在训练过程中动态调整其采样权重。RefreshGrad在不改变策略架构、训练目标或推理成本的前提下，将优化重点集中在信息丰富且可学习的时间窗口上。在十个LIBERO-Plus操作任务中，RefreshGrad在视觉扰动条件下将平均成功率从60.7%（均匀采样）和68.2%（FAKTUAL）提升至76.1%；在无干扰场景中，则从57.4%和73.3%提升至81.3%。

Authors: Dijia Zhan, Jinyi Li, Xuemiao Xu, Yan Zhou, Yu Liu, Shaoshan Liu, Jie Tang

Ferrofluid Shape Control with Deep Reinforcement Learning RLRobot

ferrofluid control deep reinforcement learning soft robotics model-based RL shape control

简要说明：本文使用深度基于模型的强化学习，通过单个电磁铁控制瞬态铁磁流体形状，成功实现了预定几何形状，为软体机器人控制开辟了新途径。

TLDR: This paper uses deep model-based reinforcement learning to control transient ferrofluid shapes via a single electromagnet, successfully achieving prescribed geometries for soft robotic applications.

Abstract: Ferrofluids are liquids containing magnetic nanoparticles, enabling shape control through external magnetic fields. This deformability supports their use as soft robotic bodies that can navigate confined spaces and manipulate objects. Their nonlinear continuum dynamics, however, make reliable control challenging. Existing work shows how spatial magnetic fields from electromagnet arrays can establish and maintain desired ferrofluid configurations. A complementary objective is to exploit the fluid's dynamics under limited actuation to reach prescribed shapes that may not be sustainable at equilibrium. Here, we use deep model-based reinforcement learning to control these transient shapes. Learning directly through physical interaction, our policies select current commands for a single fixed electromagnet based on visual observations, guiding the moving ferrofluid toward prescribed geometries. The learned policies repeatedly attain a variety of shapes spanning polygons, asterisks and pentominoes. These results demonstrate that learning directly from physical interaction enables reliable fluid shaping, opening new possibilities for controlling ferrofluid-based soft robots.

摘要（中文）：铁磁流体是含有磁性纳米颗粒的液体，可通过外部磁场实现形状控制。这种可变形特性使其能够用作软体机器人本体，在受限空间中导航并操纵物体。然而，其非线性连续介质动力学特性使得可靠控制具有挑战性。已有研究表明，电磁铁阵列产生的空间磁场能够建立并维持所需的铁磁流体构型。一个互补的目标是利用流体在有限驱动下的动力学特性，达到平衡状态下可能无法维持的规定形状。在此，我们使用基于模型的深度强化学习来控制这些瞬态形状。我们的策略直接通过物理交互进行学习，基于视觉观测为单个固定电磁铁选择电流指令，引导运动中的铁磁流体趋向规定的几何形状。学习到的策略能够重复实现多种形状，涵盖多边形、星形和五格骨牌形。这些结果表明，直接从物理交互中学习能够实现可靠的流体塑形，为控制基于铁磁流体的软体机器人开辟了新的可能性。

Authors: Anthony Czubarow, Antonio Terpin, Raffaello D'Andrea

Phantom Success, Silent Failure: Auditing the Success Checkers of Simulated Manipulation Benchmarks Manipulation

success checkers simulated manipulation benchmarks LLM-based auditing phantom successes silent failures

简要说明：本文提出SimAudit，一种基于LLM的流程，用于审计模拟操作基准中的成功检查器，在RoboTwin 2.0、RoboCasa365和RoboDojo中识别出幻影成功和静默失败，揭示了系统性缺陷并推动了更严格的评估协议。

TLDR: This paper introduces SimAudit, an LLM-based pipeline that audits success checkers in simulated manipulation benchmarks, identifying phantom successes and silent failures across RoboTwin 2.0, RoboCasa365, and RoboDojo. It reveals systematic defects and motivates more rigorous evaluation protocols for manipulation benchmarks.

Abstract: Simulated manipulation benchmarks measure policy performance using hand-written success checkers that label each episode as a success or failure. Passing an expert demonstration shows that a checker accepts one way of completing the task. Learned policies, however, may stop after partial progress or complete the task in a different way. A checker may then accept an incomplete execution (phantom success) or reject an execution that satisfies the instruction (silent failure). In this paper, we introduce SimAudit, an LLM-based pipeline that audits success checkers against task instructions. SimAudit analyzes the instruction and checker code to identify scenarios where the two may disagree, recreates those scenarios in simulation, and runs the original checker. Multi-view renderings are then used to verify whether the observed behavior satisfies the instruction. Across RoboTwin 2.0, RoboCasa365, and RoboDojo, 183 simulated test cases produced the predicted checker verdict. Visual verification and deduplication yielded 61 distinct defects across 49 tasks, including 40 phantom successes and 21 silent failures. Most defects in RoboCasa365 accepted incomplete executions, most in RoboDojo rejected valid executions, and both error types were common in RoboTwin 2.0. These findings suggest that validating success checkers requires testing both incomplete executions and valid alternatives to expert demonstrations, and motivate more rigorous evaluation protocols for future benchmarks.

摘要（中文）：模拟操作基准通过手写的成功检查器来衡量策略性能，该检查器将每一集标记为成功或失败。通过专家演示表明，检查器接受完成任务的一种方式。然而，学习到的策略可能在进行部分进展后停止，或以不同方式完成任务。此时，检查器可能会接受不完整的执行（幻影成功），或拒绝符合指令的执行（静默失败）。在本文中，我们引入了SimAudit，一种基于大语言模型的流程，用于根据任务指令审计成功检查器。SimAudit分析指令和检查器代码，以识别二者可能不一致的场景，在仿真中重现这些场景，并运行原始检查器。随后，使用多视角渲染来验证观察到的行为是否符合指令。在RoboTwin 2.0、RoboCasa365和RoboDojo中，183个仿真测试案例产生了预测的检查器判定结果。通过视觉验证和去重，我们在49个任务中发现了61个不同的缺陷，包括40个幻影成功和21个静默失败。RoboCasa365中的多数缺陷接受了不完整的执行，RoboDojo中的多数缺陷拒绝了有效的执行，而RoboTwin 2.0中两种错误类型均较为常见。这些发现表明，验证成功检查器需要同时测试不完整的执行和专家演示的有效替代方案，并促使未来的基准采用更为严格的评估协议。

Authors: Zirui Song, Jiadong Zhang, Zheng Lu, Xiaosong Ma, Xiaojun Chang, Xiuying Chen

GEMS: Generation and Experience Memory for Subgoal-Guided Long-Horizon World Model Planning WorldModel

World model planning Long-horizon Subgoal generation Latent experience memory Manipulation

简要说明：GEMS 提出了一种基于世界模型的子目标引导长时程规划方法，结合生成的时序子目标和潜在经验记忆，在操作和导航任务中提升了成功率。

TLDR: GEMS proposes a subgoal-guided long-horizon planning method with a world model, combining generated temporally structured subgoals and latent experience memory to improve success rates across manipulation and navigation tasks.

Abstract: Visual world models enable effective short-horizon goal-conditioned planning, such as reaching nearby targets and pushing objects over short distances, by predicting candidate action outcomes and comparing their representations with a goal representation. However, extending this approach to long-horizon tasks is challenging: prediction errors accumulate over extended rollouts, while latent-space similarity to distant goals provides limited guidance for ranking candidate outcomes. Existing methods address these limitations by introducing intermediate subgoals, either generated by learned models or selected from experience memory. Generated subgoals can contain hallucinations or be inaccurate in aspects such as object positions and timing. Memory-based approaches are constrained by experience coverage and may lack precise guidance for selecting appropriate intermediate states from stored observations. We introduce GEMS, which generates temporally structured subgoals to guide action search and state selection from Latent Experience Memory (LEM). A distance gate determines whether predicted outcomes are evaluated against the generated subgoal or the selected memory state. Experiments across six tasks and task suites spanning manipulation, navigation, and reaching demonstrate the effectiveness of GEMS for long-horizon planning. GEMS outperforms state-of-the-art world-model planning baselines across different manipulation settings, achieving success rates of 92.8% on Cube, 68.4% on Push-T, and 54.1% on Meta-World. It improves over the strongest evaluated baseline on these tasks by 24.0, 7.3, and 22.2 percentage points, respectively. These results demonstrate that generated subgoals and experience memory can jointly strengthen long-horizon planning with a frozen world model.

摘要（中文）：视觉世界模型通过预测候选行动结果并将其表征与目标表征进行比较，能够实现有效的短视界目标条件规划，例如到达附近目标或将物体推动短距离。然而，将这一方法扩展到长视界任务具有挑战性：预测误差会在长程推演中累积，而潜在空间中对远期目标的相似性为目标结果排序提供的指导有限。现有方法通过引入中间子目标来解决这些问题，子目标或由学习模型生成，或从经验记忆中选取。生成的子目标可能包含幻觉，或在物体位置和时间等方面不够准确。基于记忆的方法受限于经验覆盖范围，在从存储观测中选择合适的中间状态时可能缺乏精确指导。我们提出GEMS，该方法生成具有时间结构的子目标，以引导从潜在经验记忆（LEM）中进行动作搜索和状态选择。距离门控机制决定预测结果是与生成的子目标还是与选定的记忆状态进行评估比较。跨六个任务及涵盖操作、导航和到达的任务套件的实验表明，GEMS在长视界规划中具有有效性。在不同操作设置下，GEMS均优于最先进的世界模型规划基线，在Cube上达到92.8%的成功率，在Push-T上达到68.4%，在Meta-World上达到54.1%。与这些任务上最强的评估基线相比，GEMS分别提高了24.0、7.3和22.2个百分点。这些结果表明，生成的子目标与经验记忆可以共同增强使用冻结世界模型的长视界规划能力。

Authors: Yangchen Zhao, Ali Payani, Caiwen Ding

Mapping the Wind to Find the Source: Online Physics-Informed Gas Source Localization with Mobile Robots Other

gas source localization physics-informed mobile robots airflow field estimation informative path planning

简要说明：本文提出了一种轻量级物理信息概率框架，用于移动机器人在空间变化室内气流下的在线气体源定位，结合风场重建、正向扩散模型、信源信念更新和信息路径规划，以实现高效探索。

TLDR: The paper presents a lightweight physics-informed probabilistic framework for online gas source localization with mobile robots under spatially varying indoor airflow, integrating wind field reconstruction, forward dispersion modeling, belief updating, and informative path planning for efficient exploration.

Abstract: Gas Source Localization (GSL) with mobile robots is challenging because wind and gas measurements are spatially sparse, noisy, and potentially affected by robot motion. Indoor airflow can vary substantially across space, while detailed environmental layouts, boundary conditions, or precomputed airflow fields are often unavailable. Moreover, hazardous sources must be localized as quickly as possible, making exhaustive exploration impractical. This paper presents a lightweight physics-informed probabilistic framework for efficient GSL under spatially varying indoor airflow. As the robot navigates, it continuously collects wind and gas measurements and reconstructs the spatially varying airflow field online. The estimated wind field drives a forward dispersion model that predicts the gas pattern for each candidate source location. These predictions are compared with the measured gas pattern to update a probabilistic belief over the source location. As the wind field is reconstructed incrementally, the framework also accounts for the spatially non-uniform reliability of wind field estimation and its influence on the source estimation. The resulting belief map is then used for informative path planning to guide the robot toward informative regions. High-fidelity simulations provide a comprehensive evaluation of the individual components and their integrations within the complete system, while physical indoor experiments assess the system performance under realistic sensing, motion, and airflow conditions. The results demonstrate that incorporating lightweight physical knowledge significantly improves localization robustness under spatially complex airflow and enables more efficient exploration.

摘要（中文）：移动机器人的气体源定位（GSL）面临诸多挑战，原因在于风场与气体测量在空间上稀疏、噪声显著，且可能受到机器人运动的影响。室内气流在空间上变化显著，而详细的环境布局、边界条件或预先计算的气流场往往难以获取。此外，危险源必须尽快定位，使得穷举式搜索方法不切实际。本文提出了一种轻量级、基于物理信息的概率框架，用于在空间变化的室内气流条件下实现高效的气体源定位。机器人在导航过程中持续采集风场与气体测量数据，并在线重构空间变化的气流场。估计所得的风场驱动前向扩散模型，预测每个候选源位置对应的气体分布模式。将这些预测结果与实际测量到的气体分布进行比较，以更新关于源位置的概率信念。由于风场是逐步重构的，该框架还考虑了风场估计在空间上的非均匀可靠性及其对源估计的影响。由此生成的信念图随后用于信息驱动路径规划，引导机器人向信息丰富的区域移动。高保真仿真对系统各组成部分及其在完整系统中的集成进行了全面评估，而室内物理实验则在真实传感、运动及气流条件下检验了系统性能。结果表明，融入轻量级物理知识显著增强了空间复杂气流条件下定位的鲁棒性，并提升了探索效率。

Authors: Wanting Jin, Thomas Wiedemann, Han Fan, Achim Lilienthal, Alcherio Martinoli

World Models Favor Learned Priors over Visual Evidence WorldModel

world models visual calibration rule inference distribution shift TailWorld

简要说明：本文提出了跨环境世界模型基准TailWorld，并提出了RIFT方法，该方法从视觉证据中推断物理规则，以在训练不平衡的情况下预测罕见动态。

TLDR: This paper introduces TailWorld, a benchmark for cross-environment world models, and proposes RIFT, a method that infers physical rules from visual evidence to predict rare dynamics despite training imbalances.

Abstract: World models are increasingly used to simulate physical interactions, but training a separate model for each environment limits scalability. Cross-environment prediction requires identifying the current physical rule, which appearance alone may not reveal. We therefore study visual calibration: using object motion and interactions in a short video as direct evidence to infer the current rule and predict motion under that rule from a different initial state. However, differences in data availability across physical conditions can yield a long-tailed training distribution, biasing models toward common rules even when evidence supports rare ones. To study this challenge, we introduce TailWorld, which evaluates the transfer of demonstrated rules across initial states while independently controlling training imbalance and calibration informativeness. The benchmark compares predictions with two reference futures from the same prediction initial state, one following the demonstrated rule and the other a common rule, to measure prediction bias toward common dynamics. We further propose Rule Inference for Transfer (RIFT), which learns how different rules affect object motion, infers the current rule from calibration interactions, and applies it to prediction from a new initial state. RIFT explicitly controls the influence of training frequency on rule inference, allowing sufficiently informative observational evidence to support rare rules. Experiments on TailWorld show that RIFT improves prediction accuracy and physical consistency across varying training imbalances and distribution shifts, with gains in predicting rare dynamics.

摘要（中文）：世界模型越来越多地被用于模拟物理交互，但为每个环境单独训练模型限制了其可扩展性。跨环境预测需要识别当前的物理规则，而仅凭外观可能无法揭示这一规则。因此，我们研究视觉校准：利用短视频中的物体运动及其交互作为直接证据，推断当前规则，并在该规则下从不同的初始状态预测运动。然而，不同物理条件下数据可用性的差异可能导致长尾训练分布，使模型即便在证据支持稀有规则的情况下仍偏向于常见规则。为研究这一挑战，我们引入了TailWorld，该基准在独立控制训练不均衡和校准信息量的同时，评估已展示规则跨初始状态的迁移能力。该基准将预测结果与来自同一预测初始状态的两条参考未来轨迹进行比较，其中一条遵循已展示规则，另一条遵循常见规则，以衡量预测对常见动力学的偏向程度。我们进一步提出了规则推理迁移方法（RIFT），该方法学习不同规则如何影响物体运动，从校准交互中推断当前规则，并将其应用于新初始状态下的预测。RIFT显式控制训练频率对规则推理的影响，使得信息量充分的观察证据能够支持稀有规则。在TailWorld上的实验表明，RIFT在不同训练不均衡和分布偏移下提升了预测准确性和物理一致性，并在稀有动力学预测方面取得了显著改进。

Authors: Han Xiao, Zhiyong Bao, Xiaotong Liu, Yanhao Chen, Qingqiang Wu

SteerTrace: Tracing How Target Attacks Steer World Action Models WorldModel

world action models targeted universal attack adversarial attack interpretability safety

简要说明：SteerTrace 提出了一种针对世界动作模型的定向通用对抗攻击，并追踪其内部效应，揭示了安全关键动作引导在模型表示和神经元中的集中位置。研究表明，微小的扰动即可大幅降低任务成功率，并且特定的内部组件（未来令牌、FFN 神经元、残差方向）介导了攻击的定向效应。

TLDR: SteerTrace introduces a targeted universal adversarial attack for world action models that traces its internal effects, revealing where safety-critical action steering is concentrated in the model's representations and neurons. It demonstrates that small perturbations can drastically reduce task success and that specific internal components (future tokens, FFN neurons, residual directions) mediate the attack's targeted effect.

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) predict future videos and actions with one backbone, and their imagined future is often seen as a safety signal. We introduce SteerTrace, a targeted universal attack on WAMs that also traces its effect inside the model. One $\ell_\infty$-bounded (4/255) perturbation per model, shared across frames, tasks, and camera views, pushes the executed action toward an attacker-chosen target. On eight WAMs from four families (FastWAM, Faster-WAM, OpenWAM and LingBot-VA) on LIBERO and RoboTwin, it drives task success close to zero and moves the attacked action toward the target. Same-budget noise and BadWAM produce little action shift in the target direction. We use the signed targeted effect to measure how much of the effect each intervention removes or reproduces. Under the standard attack, restoring future tokens removes 61-94% of the targeted effect in the five models whose action experts attend to them. When the attack is constrained to keep the predicted future close to the clean prediction, the targeted effect can become more dependent on current-frame tokens. In three of these five models, restoring current-frame tokens removes 87-99% of the effect, compared with 9-15% for future tokens. In six models, restoring just 0.36% of the FFN neurons in layers 10-29 of the video expert removes 72-96% of the targeted effect. Residual directions 2-16 hold only 11-18% of the shift energy, yet removing them cancels most of the targeted effect.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAMs）通过单一骨干网络预测未来视频与动作，其想象出的未来常被视为安全信号。我们提出SteerTrace，一种针对WAMs的定向通用攻击，同时可在模型内部追踪其影响。每个模型仅需一个$\ell_\infty$有界（4/255）扰动，跨帧、跨任务、跨视角共享，即可将实际执行动作推向攻击者指定的目标。在来自四个系列（FastWAM、Faster-WAM、OpenWAM和LingBot-VA）的八个WAMs上，基于LIBERO和RoboTwin基准，该攻击将任务成功率降至接近零，并将受攻击动作推向目标方向。同等预算的噪声和BadWAM在目标方向上仅产生极小的动作偏移。我们利用带符号的定向效应来衡量每种干预措施消除或重现了多少效应。在标准攻击下，恢复未来token可消除五个模型中61-94%的定向效应（这些模型的动作专家会关注未来token）。当攻击被约束为使预测未来接近干净预测时，定向效应可能变得更加依赖当前帧token。在这五个模型中的三个里，恢复当前帧token可消除87-99%的效应，而恢复未来token仅能消除9-15%。在六个模型中，仅恢复视频专家第10-29层中0.36%的FFN神经元，即可消除72-96%的定向效应。残差方向2-16仅承载11-18%的偏移能量，但移除它们却能抵消大部分定向效应。

Authors: Yukun Dai, Tianshi Wang, Fengling Li, Jingjing Li, Xin Li, Lei Zhu

LATER: Learning Action-Conditioned Temporal Evidence Retrieval for Predictive World Models WorldModel

action-conditioned world model temporal evidence retrieval partitioned memory response bridge CF-JEPA

简要说明：LATER提出了一种动作条件世界模型，通过分区记忆存储真实转换，并使用响应桥检索早期交互的物理证据，从而在干扰环境下提高预测准确性。

TLDR: LATER introduces an action-conditioned world model that stores real transitions in partitioned memories and uses a response bridge to retrieve physical evidence from earlier interactions, improving prediction accuracy in distracted environments.

Abstract: Early interactions can reveal physical properties that later observations no longer show. These properties can still gov- ern the effects of future actions. Inspired by the distinction between retention and selective readout in working mem- ory and cognitive science, we introduce LATER, an action- conditioned world model built on CF-JEPA. LATER stores completed real transitions in partitioned memories that remain fixed during candidate rollouts. A response bridge queries these memories using the current state and candidate action, while multi-cut auxiliary supervision trains the memory writ- ers. On distracted Two-Stage PushT, LATER raises terminal success from 15.5% to 25.0% over reconstructed CF-JEPA. In a separate comparison across six models and two scratch- training seeds, LATER achieves the lowest mean physical readout error in both clean and distracted views, reducing along-push mean absolute error (MAE) under distractors by 20.2% relative to CF-JEPA. Controlled history interventions show that later predictions depend on earlier physical evi- dence even when query observations and actions are fixed, with larger effects during pushing than waiting.

摘要（中文）：早期交互能够揭示那些后续观测中不再显现的物理属性，而这些属性仍可能主导未来行动的效果。受工作记忆与认知科学中保持与选择性读取之区分的启发，我们提出了LATER——一种基于CF-JEPA构建的动作条件世界模型。LATER将已完成的真实状态转移存储于分区记忆中，这些记忆在候选轨迹生成期间保持固定不变。一个响应桥接模块利用当前状态与候选动作查询这些记忆，同时多截断辅助监督机制用于训练记忆写入器。在受干扰的双阶段PushT任务中，相比重建的CF-JEPA，LATER将终端成功率从15.5%提升至25.0%。在另一项涉及六种模型、两种从零训练种子的对比实验中，LATER在干净与受干扰视角下均取得了最低的平均物理读取误差，其在干扰条件下沿推动方向的平均绝对误差（MAE）较CF-JEFA降低了20.2%。受控历史干预实验表明，即便查询观测与动作保持不变，后续预测仍依赖于更早的物理证据，且推动过程中的影响大于等待过程。

Authors: Zihan Zhou, Wenxi Xu, Qilin Wang, Hao Tang

Don't Lose the Future: Latent-Aware 4-Bit Quantization of World Action Models WorldModel

world action models 4-bit quantization latent-aware model compression robotic manipulation

简要说明：本文提出了LAQ，一种针对世界动作模型的潜在感知量化框架，通过读者度量和读取计数来保留预测的未来，在LIBERO-Plus基准和真实机器人手臂上实现了接近16位性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces LAQ, a latent-aware quantization framework for world action models that preserves the predicted future by using a reader metric and read count to allocate precision, achieving near-16-bit performance on the LIBERO-Plus benchmark and a real robot arm.

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) predict how a scene will evolve and condition their actions on this predicted future. Deploying them on a robot's onboard computer calls for 4-bit weights, activations and key-value caches (W4A4KV4). Existing 4-bit quantizers for WAMs preserve the generated action, and estimate sensitivity one denoising step at a time. However, they fail to preserve the fidelity of the predicted future: once the action pathway is protected, the remaining action error enters mostly through a degraded future that none of them deliberately protects. We propose LAQ, a latent-aware quantization framework that preserves the predicted future where it is written, stored and read. Specifically, we introduce a reader metric, which measures future error by its effect on the action, and a read count, which weights each rounding error by the number of denoising steps that read it. Together they give the allocation of precision over activations and caches a closed-form solution. We further develop gaze-guided refinement, which gives the tokens the action attends to a second 4-bit pass in the denoising loop and in the cache. All weights stay at 4 bits, with no high-precision branch and no per-task recalibration. On the LIBERO-Plus benchmark, LAQ reaches 76.4% and 83.3% average success on Fast-WAM and Cosmos-Policy, within 1.2 percentage points of the 16-bit models and all above the baselines with 16-bit KV caches. It compresses the model by 3.8x, reduces the peak GPU memory of the whole policy by 2.3x, and runs 1.66x faster than the 16-bit model. On a real AgileX PiPER arm, it reaches 47.0% average success over three tasks, against 52.0% for the 16-bit model and 30.0% higher than QuaRot.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAMs）会预测场景将如何演变，并依据这一预测到的未来来调整其动作。将其部署在机器人的机载计算机上，需要4比特的权重、激活值和键值缓存（W4A4KV4）。现有的面向WAMs的4比特量化器能保留生成的动作，并逐步（每去噪一步）估计敏感性。然而，它们未能保留所预测未来的保真度：一旦动作通路得到保护，剩余的动作误差便主要经由一个退化的未来进入系统，而现有方法均未主动保护这一未来。为此，我们提出LAQ，一种潜在感知的量化框架，在未来的写入、存储和读取之处均保持其保真度。具体而言，我们引入了一个阅读器度量，通过未来误差对动作的影响来衡量未来误差，以及一个读取次数度量，将每个舍入误差按其被读取的去噪步数进行加权。二者共同为激活值和缓存上的精度分配提供了闭式解。我们进一步开发了注视引导的精化机制，使动作所关注的令牌在去噪循环和缓存中获得第二次4比特处理。所有权重保持4比特，无高精度分支，无需逐任务重新校准。在LIBERO-Plus基准上，LAQ在Fast-WAM和Cosmos-Policy上分别达到76.4%和83.3%的平均成功率，与16比特模型相差在1.2个百分点以内，且均高于使用16比特KV缓存的基线方法。其将模型压缩3.8倍，将整个策略的峰值GPU内存降低2.3倍，运行速度比16比特模型快1.66倍。在真实的AgileX PiPER机械臂上，其在三个任务中达到47.0%的平均成功率，而16比特模型为52.0%，且比QuaRot高出30.0个百分点。

Authors: Yichen Guo, Yanlong Chen, Xinyue Zhang, Mohan Liu, Song Zhang, Yawei Li

Bradley-Terry Training Can Distort Outcome Probabilities of Initially Accurate Language World Models WorldModel

Bradley-Terry objective language world models outcome probabilities comparative feedback robot push

简要说明：本文表明，在成对比较反馈上使用 Bradley-Terry 目标训练语言世界模型，会扭曲其输出概率，即使初始模型准确，也会将大量概率质量从真实结果移开。该失真源于训练目标，并会在模拟机器人推操作任务中损害下游决策。

TLDR: This paper demonstrates that Bradley-Terry training on comparative feedback can distort the outcome probabilities of language world models, moving significant probability mass away from true outcomes, even when the initial model is accurate. The distortion is traced to the training objective and can degrade downstream decisions in a simulated robot push task.

Abstract: Comparative feedback, in which a judge says which of two candidate outcomes is closer to what happened, is a practical way to train language world models that assign probabilities to an action's outcomes. We show that, fitted with a Bradley-Terry objective, it need not teach the true outcome probabilities and can distort accurate ones. On a simulated robot push with enumerated outcome distributions, this objective takes a model that is accurate on unseen layouts (hazard error 2.4 percentage points, pp) and moves 33 to 43 pp of its probability onto outcomes that none of a condition's enumerated branches produces. The cause is the objective, not the comparisons: its optimum, computed before training, predicts where the model ends up, and a likelihood that knows the judge's rule learns from the same comparisons without the shift. The shift is robust: it recurs on unseen conditions, under five candidate laws and a three-fold denser enumeration, and about 29 pp remain without the physically impossible events. Its cost is conditional: with those events it inflates hazard probabilities, and a threshold inherited from the pre-feedback model costs about 3 pp of utility per decision on trained and 1 to 2 pp on unseen conditions, through false rejects; without them the utility loss averages below 1 pp over six seeds, though a small regret in action choice remains. Audits of readout, response and decision trace the effect from probabilities to actions.

摘要（中文）：比较反馈是一种实用的语言世界模型训练方式，在该模型中，评判者会指出两个候选结果中哪一个更接近实际发生的情况，从而使模型能够为行动的结果分配概率。我们证明，若采用布拉德利-特里目标函数，这一方法未必能教会模型真实的结果概率，甚至可能扭曲原本准确的概率。在一项基于枚举结果分布的模拟机器人推操作任务中，该目标函数使一个在未见布局上表现准确的模型（危险误差为2.4个百分点）将其33至43个百分点的概率转移至某一条件所枚举分支均不会产生的结果上。问题的根源在于目标函数本身，而非比较数据：其最优解在训练前即可计算得出，并能预测模型的最终状态；而一个知晓评判者规则的似然函数则能从相同的比较数据中学习，却不会发生概率偏移。该偏移具有稳健性：它在未见条件、五种候选法则以及三倍密集的枚举设置下反复出现，即便排除物理上不可能的事件后，仍约有29个百分点的偏移残留。其代价是条件性的：当存在这些不可能事件时，它会抬高危险概率；而源自反馈前模型的阈值在训练条件下每决策造成约3个百分点的效用损失，在未见条件下造成约1至2个百分点的损失，主要体现为错误拒绝；若排除这些事件，则在六个随机种子下效用损失平均低于1个百分点，尽管在行动选择上仍存在较小的遗憾。对读数、响应和决策的审计揭示了从概率到行动的效应传导路径。

Authors: Xinze Shi, Litian Zhang, Zhenjie Su, Zelong Yu, Yuting Zhang, Qihua Feng, Zifeng Kang, Chaozhuo Li, Zhengxuan Hu

WorldRuler: Interactive World Modeling under Configurable Rules WorldModel

world models rule graph video generation rule-conditioned interaction state persistence

简要说明：WorldRuler通过可执行的3D规则图和规则执行、视频生成与感知反馈的闭环，使世界模型能遵循用户自定义规则，在保存/加载时保持规则与状态一致性，并准确将规则效果应用到指定对象（即使未见）。作者构建了RuleVerse数据集并验证了其有效性。

TLDR: WorldRuler introduces an executable 3D rule graph and closed-loop rule execution with video generation, enabling world models to follow user-defined rules across saving/loading and accurately apply state changes to designated objects, even when unseen. They construct the RuleVerse dataset and demonstrate effectiveness in preserving rule-state consistency and realizing rule outcomes.

Abstract: Rules govern how player actions change interactive worlds. Different rules create distinct gameplay experiences within similar scenes and action spaces. For customizable gameplay, generative world models must follow user-defined rules beyond real-world behaviors. However, realizing user-defined rules presents two challenges: Rule-State Persistence and Rule-to-Visual Realization. The former requires preserving rule definitions, dependencies, and world states across saving and loading, so that restored worlds follow the established rules. The latter requires accurately realizing rule-induced changes on designated objects and attributes, particularly when affected objects are unseen. In this paper, we propose WorldRuler, which organizes rule definitions, dependencies, and object states in an executable 3D rule graph and connects rule execution, video generation, and perceptual feedback in a closed loop. The graph supports joint saving and restoration of rules and world states, while dynamic object binding grounds rule-specified entities in visual instances and uses stored states to constrain generation from their first appearance. We further introduce object attribute state replacement and counterfactual reconstruction training, enabling accurate attribute control and compatible appearance and motion changes while limiting interference with unrelated content. We develop an automated data collection and annotation pipeline using GTA-V and Habitat to construct RuleVerse, a dataset of rule-driven interactions with detailed state and event annotations, including cases where rules take effect before affected objects become visible. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of WorldRuler in preserving rule-state consistency across saving and loading and accurately realizing rule outcomes on designated objects and attributes.

摘要（中文）：规则决定了玩家行为如何改变交互式世界。在相似的场景与动作空间中，不同的规则会营造出截然不同的游戏体验。为了实现可定制的游戏玩法，生成式世界模型必须遵循用户自定义的规则，而不仅仅局限于真实世界的行为。然而，实现用户自定义规则面临两大挑战：规则-状态持久化（Rule-State Persistence）与规则到视觉的实现（Rule-to-Visual Realization）。前者要求在保存与加载过程中保留规则定义、依赖关系及世界状态，使得恢复后的世界仍遵循既定规则。后者则要求在指定对象和属性上准确实现规则引发的变更，尤其是在受影响对象尚未可见的情况下。本文提出WorldRuler，它通过可执行的3D规则图组织规则定义、依赖关系及对象状态，并将规则执行、视频生成与感知反馈连接成闭环。该规则图支持规则与世界状态的联合保存与恢复，同时，动态对象绑定将规则指定的实体锚定到视觉实例中，并利用存储的状态从其首次出现起便约束生成过程。我们进一步引入对象属性状态替换与反事实重建训练，在实现对属性精确控制的同时，生成兼容的外观与运动变化，并尽量减少对无关内容的干扰。我们利用GTA-V和Habitat构建了自动化数据采集与标注流程，创建了RuleVerse数据集，其中包含带有详细状态与事件标注的规则驱动交互样本，并涵盖了规则在受影响对象可见之前便已生效的情形。大量实验证明了WorldRuler在保存与加载过程中保持规则与状态一致性，以及在指定对象和属性上准确实现规则结果方面的有效性。

Authors: Mingliang Zhai, Chuanhao Li, Jiaming Tan, Zhen Li, Yuwei Wu, Yunde Jia, Zian Meng, Yuanyang Yin, Kaipeng Zhang

SpecWM: Turning Verification into Refinement for Streaming World Models WorldModel

speculative decoding streaming world models latent velocity field training-free inference navigation generation

简要说明：SpecWM 提出了一种无需训练的推理框架，通过利用目标模型的潜在速度场验证草稿块，并将验证信号转化为修正用于细化，从而在导航生成中实现更好的质量-速度权衡。

TLDR: SpecWM is a training-free inference framework that accelerates streaming world models by using the target model's latent velocity field to verify draft chunks, converting verification signals into corrections for refinement, achieving better quality-speed trade-offs in navigation generation.

Abstract: Recently, video world models have advanced interactive generation, with large models offering higher quality and smaller models enabling faster inference. Existing speculative methods combine their strengths through fast draft generation and selective target regeneration guided by rewards on decoded frames. However, verification covers only the external scorer's evaluation dimensions and adds decoding and scoring costs. Moreover, these scores provide no correction, requiring costly target regeneration for rejected drafts. To address these limitations, we propose Speculative World Model (SpecWM), a unified, training-free inference framework for streaming world models. It verifies draft chunks using the target's latent velocity field. Verification also yields a reusable correction; two thresholds select Accept, Refine, or Reject. Specifically, one-step refinement reuses it to improve perceptual quality, while three-step refinement strengthens camera following and trajectory consistency. These findings motivate transition-aware refinement. On WBench Navigation, SpecWM improves visual quality at 1.63$\times$ speedup over the target and raises NavScore from the draft's 75.99 to 85.63, achieving the best quality-speed-control trade-off. Additionally, our LongSpecBench shows sustained quality and control over long, multi-turn rollouts, while experiments on Hy-Nomas validate SpecWM across backbones and denoising budgets.

摘要（中文）：最近，视频世界模型推进了交互式生成的发展，其中大型模型提供更高质量，而小型模型则实现更快的推理速度。现有的投机方法通过快速草稿生成和基于解码帧奖励的选择性目标再生成，结合了二者的优势。然而，验证仅覆盖外部评分器的评估维度，并增加了解码和评分成本。此外，这些分数不提供修正功能，对于被拒绝的草稿需要进行昂贵的目标再生成。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了投机世界模型（Speculative World Model，SpecWM），一个统一的、无需训练的流式世界模型推理框架。该方法利用目标的潜在速度场对草稿块进行验证。验证过程还会产生可复用的修正信息；两个阈值分别选择接受（Accept）、精炼（Refine）或拒绝（Reject）。具体而言，单步精炼复用该信息以提升感知质量，而三步精炼则增强相机跟随和轨迹一致性。这些发现促使我们提出过渡感知的精炼策略。在WBench导航基准上，SpecWM以1.63倍于目标模型的速度提升了视觉质量，并将导航分数（NavScore）从草稿模型的75.99提升至85.63，实现了质量-速度-控制的最佳权衡。此外，我们提出的LongSpecBench基准表明，在长序列多轮生成中，模型能保持持续的质量和控制能力；同时，在Hy-Nomas上的实验验证了SpecWM在不同骨干网络和去噪预算下的有效性。

Authors: Jiaming Li, Lingzhen Li, Xiaze Yang, Chenyu Zhu, Kaiqi Liu, Xiaotong Zhao, Songlian Li, Toyota Li, Alan Zhao, Haobin Zhong, Yue Ma, Zhiyuan Ma

Fixing the Twin, Not the Detector: Sim-to-Real Roadside LiDAR Detection from Digital-Twin Data Perception3D

sim-to-real roadside LiDAR detection digital twin CenterPoint point density resampling

简要说明：本文提出了一种仅使用合成数字孪生数据进行路边LiDAR检测的仿真到真实管道，并在UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR挑战赛中赢得LUMPI赛道。其核心在于修正数字孪生与真实传感器之间的系统性差异（如坐标对齐、点密度、框约定、生成缺失目标类别），而非改进检测器，并证明针对系统性差异的组件在验证集上的增益能有效迁移到测试集。

TLDR: This paper presents a pipeline for sim-to-real roadside LiDAR detection using only synthetic digital-twin data, winning the LUMPI track of the UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge. It focuses on correcting systematic differences between the digital twin and real sensor (coordinate alignment, point density, box conventions, generating missing object classes) rather than improving the detector, and shows that component gains validated on a small set transfer to the test set when they address systematic sim-to-real gaps.

Abstract: Roadside LiDAR detectors are expensive to train on real labels, and digital twins promise to replace these labels, but a detector trained on a twin meets a different sensor, different objects and different annotation conventions on the real site. We describe the pipeline that placed first in the LUMPI track of the UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge (IEEE BigData 2026 Cup, 0.5541 combined score) and fifth on its V2X-Real track (0.8102). Every detector is a CenterPoint model trained only on synthetic data, on a single 8 GB laptop GPU. Most of the gain came from correcting differences between the twin and the real site rather than from the detector. We align the twin's coordinates, point density and box convention with the test sensor, generate the pedestrians and riders that the twins lack, plus street clutter as unlabeled negatives, and rebuild twin objects at real size and real point density. A non-learned resampling to the per-cell point density of unlabeled real frames lifts LUMPI realism from 0.589 to 0.947, against 0.949 between real frames. Label-free post-processing then exploits what a fixed roadside sensor guarantees: static structures recur in every frame, and real objects have characteristic point statistics. Reporting the validation and test gain of each component side by side, we find that corrections of systematic sim-to-real differences transfer to the test set, typically keeping a quarter to three quarters of their validation gain, while choices that fit the few objects of a validation set do not.

摘要（中文）：摘要：路侧激光雷达探测器在真实标签上训练成本高昂，而数字孪生有望替代这些标签，但在孪生环境中训练的探测器在真实场景中会遇到不同的传感器、不同的物体以及不同的标注规范。我们描述了在UrbanTwin Sim2Real激光雷达挑战赛（IEEE BigData 2026杯，综合得分0.5541）LUMPI赛道中排名第一、在其V2X-Real赛道中排名第五（得分0.8102）的处理流程。每个探测器均为CenterPoint模型，仅使用合成数据训练，运行在单块8 GB笔记本GPU上。大部分增益来自于修正孪生环境与真实场景之间的差异，而非探测器本身。我们将孪生环境的坐标、点密度和框标注规范与测试传感器对齐，生成孪生环境缺失的行人和骑行人员，并将街道杂乱物作为未标注负样本加入，同时按真实尺寸和真实点密度重建孪生物体。一种无需学习的重采样方法，将未标注真实帧的逐单元点密度对齐后，将LUMPI真实感得分从0.589提升至0.947，而真实帧之间的得分为0.949。随后，无需标签的后处理利用了固定路侧传感器所具有的特性：静态结构在每帧中重复出现，真实物体具有特征性的点统计特征。通过并排报告每个组件在验证集和测试集上的增益，我们发现对系统性的仿真到真实差异的修正能够迁移到测试集，通常保留其验证增益的四分之一至四分之三，而针对验证集中少量物体所做的选择则无法迁移。

Authors: KuanLin Chen, Feng-jui Kuo

What One Sample Cannot See: Why Fewer Denoising Steps Can Score Higher on Physics Benchmarks WorldModel

world model evaluation physics benchmark Kernel Physics-IQ video generation denoising steps

简要说明：本文分析了为什么在视频世界模型的物理基准测试中，较少的去噪步骤可能提高分数，表明官方Physics-IQ指标奖励生成未来的减少变异性。提出了Kernel Physics-IQ，每个条件仅需两个独立样本即可消除这一激励，并在多个图像到视频模型中证明了它倾向于准确的分布而非坍缩的预测。

TLDR: This paper analyzes why fewer denoising steps can inflate physics benchmark scores for video-based world models, showing that the official Physics-IQ metric rewards reduced variation in generated futures. It introduces Kernel Physics-IQ, which requires two independent samples per condition to remove this incentive, and demonstrates that it favors accurate distributions over collapsed predictions across several image-to-video models.

Abstract: When a storm can head north or south, a forecast down the middle may score better under squared error than either plausible path. The same paradox appears when video generators are tested as world models: fewer denoising steps can raise physics scores even as videos blur or stop moving early. Why? Physics-IQ compares each generated video with one recording, although a scene can have multiple valid futures. An exact decomposition shows its scores can reward reduced variation among generated futures, even when their distribution becomes less accurate. We introduce Kernel Physics-IQ to remove this incentive in expectation, needing only two independent samples per condition. Two-step sampling lowers Kernel Physics-IQ in all five image-to-video models. For CogVideoX, the official score rises by 0.055 while ours falls by 0.131. Changing the sampling schedule reveals further differences official scores miss. In controlled physical systems with known outcome probabilities, our metric favors the true distribution over collapsed predictions. In short, a world model should be judged not only by how closely one video matches what happened, but by how faithfully its predictions represent what could have happened.

摘要（中文）：当风暴可能向北或向南移动时，预测其中间路径在均方误差下可能比任一台理路径得分更高。这一悖论同样出现在视频生成器作为世界模型进行测试时：更少的去噪步骤可以提升物理学评分，即使视频变得模糊或过早停止运动。原因何在？Physics-IQ将每个生成视频与一段真实记录进行比较，尽管一个场景可能存在多种有效的未来走向。精确分解表明，该评分可能奖励生成未来之间变异性的减少，即使其分布变得不那么准确。我们引入核Physics-IQ，以在期望意义上消除这一激励，仅需每种条件下的两个独立样本。两步采样在所有五种图像到视频模型中均降低了核Physics-IQ。对于CogVideoX，官方评分上升了0.055，而我们的评分则下降了0.131。改变采样调度方案揭示了官方评分所遗漏的进一步差异。在结果概率已知的受控物理系统中，我们的指标倾向于真实分布而非坍缩预测。简而言之，世界模型的评判标准不应仅在于某个视频与实际发生情况的匹配程度，还在于其预测忠实呈现可能发生的多种情况的能力。
